title.zh: Ethereum Now Lets You Pay for AI Without Revealing Who You Are
title.en: Ethereum Now Lets You Pay for AI Without Revealing Who You Are

current_state.zh: The Ethereum Foundation launched zkAPI on Ethereum mainnet, letting users prepay in USDC and receive capped, short-lived API keys via zero-knowledge proofs so they can use AI services without linking their identity to their prompts.
current_state.en: The Ethereum Foundation launched zkAPI on Ethereum mainnet, letting users prepay in USDC and receive capped, short-lived API keys via zero-knowledge proofs so they can use AI services without linking their identity to their prompts.
